turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi Mr Tan, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Doc, my left hip is sore, but not too bad lah. I can tolerate it.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Okay, can you rate your pain on a scale of 0 to 10 for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe 4 or 5? It’s a dull pain, not sharp one.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or vomiting since waking up?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: A bit dizzy earlier, but no vomiting. Stomach feels okay now.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: How’s your breathing? Any tightness or discomfort in your chest?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is fine, but my throat is a bit dry. Maybe from the tube during surgery?

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That’s normal. Did you remember anything during the operation?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I was out cold. Only woke up when they moved me here.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any chest pain, shortness of breath, or unusual symptoms linked to your blood pressure or sugar levels?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Blood pressure been stable, no chest pain. My sugar was 7.2 this morning, so okay lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Let us know if you need more pain relief or feel unwell. Rest well, Mr Tan.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Thanks, doc. I’ll let the nurse know if anything comes up.
